title: נבא
content:
[Str5012–13] נבא (√ of foll.; v. BH id., but esp. BewerAm. J. Sem. Lang., Jan. 1902 who cp. As. nabû, tear away, lead forcibly, hence proph. as (fig.) carried away by divine frenzy, ecstasy, cf. 1 S 10:6, 10:10, 19:20, 19:24).

[Str5029,5030] † [נְבִרא] n.m. prophet (Hebraism? also Targum Syr.; v. BH);—emph. נְבִיאָה Kt, נְבִיָּא Ezr 5:1, 6:14; pl. emph. נְבִיאַיָּא 5:1, 5:2.

[Str5017] † [נְבוּאָה] n.f. prophesying;—cstr. נְבוּאַת Ezr 6:14.

[Str5019–20] נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר:31 n.pr.m. (= BH רֶאצַּר-, etc.);—Dn 2:28 + 23 t. Dn, Ezr 5:12, 5:14, 6:5; ´נְבֻכ: Dn 3:3 + 3 t. Dn.

[Str5023] † נְבִזְבָּה n.f. reward (so Targum (rare); prob. Pers. loan-word, HaugEW. Jahrb. 1853, 160 prop. OP * nibaǧrâ, presentation; but perh. crpt.,v. M71 *);—abs. ´נ: Dn 2:6; pl. sf. נְבָֽזְבְּיָתָךְ (al. ´נְבַז:, ´נְבִז:) 5:17.

[Str5043] † נֶבְרַשְׁתָּא n.f. emph. the candlestick (Targum id., Syr. ܢܒܪܫܬܐ, NH נַבְרֶשֶׁת; Ar. نِبْرَاس is loan-word from Aram. Frä95; prob. foreign word K§ 62 Fra95 Bev al.; ? As., cf. BaZA ii. 117);—Dn 5:5.

title: נְגַד
content: [Str5047] † [נְגַד] vb. stream, flow (Targum נְגַד, Syr. ܢܓܕ draw along, lead, Targum also intrans. move along Is 30:24, flow Dt 33:13, 33:22, נַגְדִּין streams Is 44:4 +);—Pe. Pt. Dn 7:10 נְהַר דִּי נגֵד וְנָפֵק מִן־קֳדָמוֺהִי.

title: נֶ֫גֶד
content: [Str5049,5048] ‡ † נֶ֫גֶד prep. in front of, facing (= BH, v. √ p. 616:b; not elsewhere known in Aram.), Dn 6:11 נגד ירושׁלם.

title: נ֫גַהּ
content: [Str5053,5051] † [נ֫גַהּ] n.[f.] brightness, daylight (Targum Syr.; BH id.);—emph. בְּנָגְהָא (K§ 54 c), 1) Dn 6:20.

title: נְדַב
content: [Str5069,5068] † [נְדַב] vb. Hithpa. volunteer, offer freely (Targum BH נָדַב);—Pf. 3 mpl. הִתְנַדַּ֫בוּ Ezr 7:15; Inf. הִתְנַדָּבוּת v:16; Pt. v:13; pl. מִתְנַדַּב v:13; pl. דְּבִין- v:16;—1. volunteer, sq. inf., Ezr 7:13. 2. give, or offer freely, v:15, acc. rei + ל of God; v:16, c. ל of temple; freewill gift (inf., prop. freewill giving) v:16.

title: נִדְבָּךְ
content: [Str5073] † נִדְבָּךְ n.m. row or layer, course (Targum NH id.; NH also מִדְבָּךְ id. (LevyNHWB iii. 23), cf. مَدْمَاكٌ as loan-word Frä12; borrowed from As. nadbaku, mountain-slope acc. to DlPr 150 (cf. BaZA ii. 115 f. HptGN 1883, 96; BAS i. 8.15), but mng. not very suitable NöZMG xi (1886), 733 MeyEntst. J. 46);—abs. ´נ: Ezr 6:4, pl. נִדְבָּכִין v:4.

title: נְדַד
content:
[Str5074–75] † [נְדַד] vb. flee (v. BH I. נדד);—Pe. Pf. 3 fs. שִׁנְּתֵהּ נַדַּת עֲלוֺהִי (K§ 46, Beisp. a)) Dn 6:19.

[Str5085,5084] † נִדְֵ+נה (Mas Baer) n.[m.] sheath (Targum נְדָן, לְדָן; v. BH (late) נָדָן, Pers. loan-word);—´בְּנ…:: Dn 7:15 my spirit in (its) sheath, i.e. my body; < נִדְנָה emph., or sf. נִדְנַהּ (K§ 54, 3. β)); or (NöGGA. 1884, 1022 Bev) נְדָנַהּ; but expression at best strange; rd. prob. בְּגִין דְּנָה on account of this (בְּגִין as TargumJ; D§ 47.3 (2nd ed. 47.10)), M72* cf. Buhl Dr.

[Str5102–03] † נְהַר:14 n.m.:Dn 7:10 river (v. BH I. נהר);—abs. ´נ: Dn 7:10; emph. נַהֲרָה Ezr 4:10 +, אָ֯, 4:16;—river, usu. of Euphr., in phr. ´עֲבַר נ: Ezr 4:10, 4:11, 4:16 + 10 t. Ezr; דִּי־נוּר ´נ: Dn 7:10 a river of fire, in vision.

[Str5094,5102] † [נְהִיר, נְהוֺר] n.m. light (Targum נְהוֺרָא, Syr. ܢܗܘܪܐ; v. BH II. נהר);—emph. נהירא Kt, < נְהוֺרָא Qr (cf. Targum Syr.; NöLCB 1896, 703) Dn 2:22.

[Str5094] † נַהִירוּ (K§§ 16.5; 61,4) n.f. illumination, insight (Syr. id.);—abs. Dn 5:11, 5:14 (both + שָכְלְתָנוּ, חָכְמָה).

title: נוּד
content:
[Str5075,5111,5110] † [נוּד] vb. flee (Targum Syr.; cf. [נְדַד] supra and BH נוּד 1 a);—Pe. Impf. 3 fs. תְּנֻד מִן Dn 4:11.

[Str5122] † נְוָלוּ, נְוָלִר (K§ 61, 4. 5) n.f. refuse-heap (Targum נְוָלִי dung-heap; perh. loan-word fr. As. namâlu (nawâlu), ruin, JenKB vi. 363);—נְוָלוּ Ezr 6:11, נְוָלִי Dn 2:5, 3:29.

[Str5135,5216] נוּר:17 n.f.:Dn 3:6 et m.:7:9 fire (Targum Syr.; v. √ נור BH);—abs. ´נ: Dn 3:27, 7:9, 7:9, 7:10; emph. נוּרָא 3:6 + 12 t. 3.

title: נְזַק
content:
[Str5142] † [נְזַק] vb. suffer injury (Targum id.; As. nazâḳu, injure; on combin. with Ar. نقص impair, v. Baes 51 FräBAS iii. 81);—Pe. Pt. נִָ+זק Dn 6:3. Haph. injure: Impf. 3 fs. תְּהַנְִ+זק (K§ 33, 2) Ezr 4:13 (acc. Pers.). Pt. act. f. cstr. מְהַנְזְקַת מַלְכְין v:15; Inf. cstr. ´לְהַנְזָתַ מ: v:22 (Kib. d); M§ 48 c קֻת-).

[Str5174,5154,5178] † נֶחָשׁ n.m. copper, bronze (Targum Syr.; BH נְחשֶׁת, נְחוּשָׁה, √ III. נחשׁ);—as material: abs. ´נ: Dn 2:32, 4:12, 4:20, 7:19; emph. נְחָשָׁא 2:35, 2:39, 2:45, 5:4, 5:23.

title: נְחֵת
content: [Str5181–82] † [נְחֵת] vb. descend (Targum Syr.; v. BH (poet., and late));—Pe. Pt. נָחִָת Dn 4:10, 4:20 (both מִן־שְׁמַיָּא). Haph. deposit, ב loc.: Impf. 2 ms. תַּחֵת (K§ 42, b)) Ezr 6:5 (GuHpt reads 3 mpl.); Imv. ms. אֲחֵת (K§ 15 d)) 5:15 (acc. rei); Pt. pass. pl. מְהַחֲתִין 6:1 (were) deposited. Hoph. (WCG 225) be deposed: Pf. 3 ms. הָנְחַת Dn 5:20 (מִן־כָּרְסֵא).

title: נְטַל
content: [Str5190–91] † [נְטַל] vb. lift (Targum Syr.; BH (rare));—Pe. Pf. 1 S. עַיְנִי לִשְׁמַיָּא נִטְלֵת Dn 4:31 (As. naṭâlu = look). Pe‘îl (WCG 224) be lifted: Pf. 3 fs. נְמִילַת מִן־אַרְעָא 7:4.

title: נְטַר
content:
[Str5202,534l,5201] † [נְטַר] vb. keep (Targum Syr.; v. BH I. נצר, and (rarely) נָטַר);—Pe. Pf. 1 S. מִלְּתָא בְּלִבִּי נִמְרֵת Dn 7:28.

[Str5208,5207] † [נִרחוֺךְַ] n.[m.] soothing, tranquillizing (prob. Hebraism, v. BH id., √ נוּחַ (√ also Targum Syr.));—pl. חִין(וֺ)נִיח Ezr 6:10, Dn 2:46 i.e. soothing offerings.

[Str5232,5233] † [נְכַס] n.[m.], pl. נִכְסִין riches, property (Targum Syr.; Eg. Aram. S-CE 4 +; BH (late))—´עֲנָשׁ נ: Ezr 7:26 confiscation of property; cstr. נִכְסֵי 6:8.

[Str5245–46] † נְמַר n.[m.] leopard (v. BH);—abs. Dn 7:6.

title: נְסַךְ
content: [Str5255–56] † [נְסַךְ] vb. pull away (Targum; v. BH);—Hithpe. be pulled away: Impf. 3 ms. יִתְנְסַךְ Ezr 6:11 (מִן).

title: נְסַךְ
content:
[Str5258,5260] † נְסַךְ vb. pour out (v. BH I. נָסַךְ);—Pa. (more gen.): Inf. לְנַסָּכָה לֵהּ Dn 2:46 to offer in sacrifice to him, c. acc. מִנְחָה וְנִיחֹחִין.

[Str5261,5262] † [נְסַךְ] n.[m.] drink-offering (Targum Syr.; cf. BH);—pl. sf. נִסְכֵּיהוֺן Ezr 7:17 (+ מִנְחָֽתְהוֺן, etc.).

[Str5267] נסק v. סלק. p. 1104

title: נְפַל
content: [Str5307–08] † נְפַל vb. fall (v. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´נ: Dn 2:46; נְפַָל 4:28; 3 mpl. נְפַ֫לוּ 3:23 + 7:20 Kt (Qr 3 fpl. נְפַ֫לָה, K§ 23, 2); Impf. 3 ms. יִפֵּל (K§ 42) Dn 3:6 +; 2 mpl. תִּפְּלוּן 3:5, 3:15; Pt. pl. נָֽפְלִין 3:7—1. fall, עַל־אַנְפּוֺהִי Dn 2:46; fall down and do homage 3:5, 3:6, 3:7, 3:10, 3:11, 3:15; ל loc. 3:23; of voice, מִן־שְׁמַיָּא 4:28. 2. fall by violence 7:20 (c. קֳדָם). 3. יִפֵּל לָךְ Ezr 7:20 it shall fall to thee (thou shalt need) to give (cf. Chr-Pal. SchulthLex. 126 and ZAW xxii (1902), 163).

title: נְכַּק
content:
[Str5312] נְכַּק vb. go, or come, out, forth (Targum id., NH נָפַק, Syr. ܢܦܫ, so Chr-Pal. SchulthLex. 126, OAram. Nab. Palm. נפק Lzb324, cf. Ar. نَافِقَأُ hole of field mouse; v. also Aram. נַפְקוּתָא, ܢܦܩܬܐ outlay, Eg. Aram. נפקתה CookeInscr. 212, Ar. نَفَقَةٌ household outlay (Aram. loan-word SchwallyZMG iii (1898). 133));—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´נ: Dn 2:14 he went out, c. inf.; 3 fs. נֶפְקַת v:13 decree went forth (cf. Lu 2:1); 3 mpl. נפְקַו 5:5 Kt (Qr 3 fpl. נְפַ֫קָה, K§ 23, 2) fingers came forth; c. מִן loc.: Imv. mpl. פֻּקוּ (K§ 42) 3:26 come forth! Pt. pl. נָֽפְקִין v:26 (both of men); sg. נָפֵק 7:10 (= flow out). Haph. bring forth, acc. rei + מִן loc.: Pf. 3 ms. הַנְפֵּק Ezr 5:14, 5:14, 6:5, Dn 5:2; 3 mpl. הַנְפִּ֫קוּ v:3 (so Eg. Aram. S-CPap. D 15, 17+).

[Str5313] † [נִפְקָה] n.f. outlay;—emph. נִפְקְתָא Ezr 6:4, 6:8.

[Str5324,5326] † [נִצְבָּה] n.f. firmness (v. BH נצב);—emph. נִצְבְּתָא Dn 2:41.

title: נְצַח
content: [Str5329–30] † [נְצַח] vb. Hithpa. distinguish oneself (v. BH I. נצח);—Pt. מִתְנַצַּח Dn 6:4, עַל Pers.

title: נְצַל
content:
[Str5337–38] † [נְצַל] vb. Haph. rescue, deliver (v. BH Eg. Aram. הנצל take away, S-CC 10, D 18);—of God, abs.: Pt. act. מַצִּל 6:28, Inf. לְהַצָּלָה Dn 3:29; of man, sf. Pers. לְהַצָּלוּתֵהּ 6:15.

[Str5343,5352] † נְקֵא adj. clean, pure (v. BH נקה);—´כַּעֲמַר נ: Dn 7:9 like pure wool.

title: נְקַשׁ
content: [Str5367–68] † [נְקַשׁ] vb. knock (v. BH (rare));—Pe. Pt. act. fpl. נָֽקְשָׁן Dn 5:6 of knees knocking דָּא לְדָא.

title: נְשָא
content:
[Str5375–76] † נְשָא vb. lift, take, carry (cf. BH; rare in Aram.; v. נְסִי, נְסָא ChWB, NHWB);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´נ: Dn 2:35 carry away (of wind, c. acc. rei); Imv. ms. שֵא Ezr 5:15 take (acc. vessels). Hithpa. make a rising, an insurrection: Pt. fs. מִתְנַשְּאָה Ezr 4:19, עַל Pers.

[Str5389] נְשֵׁיהוֺן v. [נָשִׁין] sub II. אנשׁ. p. 1081

[Str5395–97] † [נִשְׁמָה] n.f. breath (v. BH, √ נשׁם);—sf. נִשְׁמְתָח Dn 5:23, i.e. breath of life.

[Str5403,5404] † נְשַׁר n.m. griffon-vulture or eagle (v. BH);—abs. ´נ: Dn 7:4; pl. abs. נִשְׁרִין 4:30.

[Str5407,5406] † [נִשְׁתְּרָן] n.m.:Ezr 4:18 letter (prob. Pers.; v. BH);—emph. נִשְׁתְוָנָא Ezr 4:18, 4:23, 5:5.

[Str5412,5411,5414] † [נְתִינִרן] n.m.pl. Nₑthinîn (prob. loan-word from BH נְתִינִים, √ נָתַן);—servants of sanctuary, emph. נְתִינַיָּא Ezr 7:24.

title: נְתַן
content:
[Str5414–15] † [נְתַן] vb. give (v. BH; Targum rare; OAram. נתן, Impf. ינתן, so Nab.; Zinj. Palm. יתן; Eg. Aram. Impf. אנתן, ינתן, etc., S-CPap. A 7 +, pl. sf. תנתנונה ib.:J 9, Inf. למנתן S-CC 6, 9+);—Pe. Impf. 3 ms. יִנְתִּ־ן (K§ 42) Dn 2:16, sf. יִתְּנִנַּהּ 4:15 +; 2 ms. תִּנְתֵּן Ezr 7:20; 3 mpl. יִנְתְּנוּן 4:13; Inf. לְמִנְתַָּן 7:20;—1. give, subj. God, c. sf. rei + ל Pers., Dn 4:14, 4:22, 4:29. 2. of man, give, allow, acc. time, 2:16. 3. give, pay, acc. rei, Ezr 4:13, 7:20 (+ מִן of source), abs. v:20.

[Str4978] † [מַתְּנָא] n.f. gift;—pl. abs. מַתְּנָן Dn 2:6, 2:48; sf. מַתְּנָתָךְ 5:17.

[Str5426] † [נְתַר] vb. Haph. strip off (Targum נְתַר fall off; Syr. ܢܬܪ; Ar. نَثَرَ scatter; As. našâru, diminish, shorten, NH נָשַׁר fall off);—Imv. mpl. אַתַּ֫רוּ (K§ 42 b)) Dn 4:11 (acc. of leaves).

[Str5443] סַבְּכָא v. שַבְּכָא. p. 1113
